label: Measurement foundations
description: Build precise measurement vocabulary before formulas: definitions, denominators, windows, distributions and anti-gaming guardrails.
descriptionUk: Спочатку точна мова вимірювання: definitions, denominators, windows, distributions і guardrails проти gaming.

label: QA & product quality metrics
description: Turn defect, customer and QA signals into defined KPIs and a small decision-oriented scorecard.
descriptionUk: Перетворіть defect, customer і QA signals на визначені KPI та невеликий decision-oriented scorecard.

label: Test execution & automation metrics
description: Measure execution evidence and automated-feedback health without confusing green dashboards with product quality.
descriptionUk: Вимірюйте execution evidence і health автоматизованого feedback, не плутаючи green dashboard із product quality.

label: Delivery & production metrics
description: Connect flow, DORA and production-reliability signals while keeping each model’s definitions distinct.
descriptionUk: Поєднайте flow, DORA та production-reliability signals, не змішуючи definitions різних models.

label: Estimation foundations & decomposition
description: Separate estimates from commitments, expose hidden testing work, and use ranges, evidence and decomposition before choosing a formula.
descriptionUk: Відокремлюйте оцінки від зобов’язань, робіть видимою приховану тестову роботу та використовуйте діапазони, докази й декомпозицію до вибору формули.

label: Estimation techniques & sizing
description: Use expert collaboration, three-point reasoning and calibrated sizing methods as tools—not universal conversions.
descriptionUk: Використовуйте expert collaboration, three-point reasoning і calibrated sizing як інструменти, а не універсальні коефіцієнти.

label: Risk-based allocation & forecasting
description: Allocate scarce test effort deliberately and forecast completion from observed flow and uncertainty.
descriptionUk: Свідомо розподіляйте обмежений test effort і прогнозуйте completion з observed flow та uncertainty.

label: Calibration & communication
description: Close the loop: compare estimates with actuals, reforecast deliberately and communicate uncertainty without fake precision.
descriptionUk: Закрийте feedback loop: порівнюйте estimates з actuals, свідомо reforecast і комунікуйте uncertainty без fake precision.
